name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
purpose: Outcome language for the risks of AI systems, so leadership can weigh and resource them.
what: Four functions: Govern, Map, Measure and Manage. NIST says a revision is under way.

verifiedBy.line: No certification. An organization describes its own practice against the functions.

sits.line: The AI column, beside the five layers: what good looks like when the system is AI.

terms.line: A work of the United States government. Lensatic shows the card only for now.

related.line: The same shape as the CSF: functions and outcomes, for AI risk.
The Cyber AI Profile applies the CSF’s functions to AI.
ATLAS catalogs the attacks on AI systems that these outcomes guard against.
